scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF peer screen to recently published DXF implementations, establish route and source-lineage boundaries, and update the existing parity and 3D plans without increasing the fast validation loop.

findings.evidence: The tagged pre-v1 Go package documentation reports ASCII/binary DXF R12-AC1032 read/write and exposes typed APIs for explicit entities including MESH, 3DFACE, SOLID and polyface/polygon mesh. Package documentation and README are capability claims, not executed conformance results.
findings.licenseAndRelease: pkg.go.dev identifies MIT license and publication on 2026-10-01; v0.3.3 is pre-v1.
findings.lineage: Its README explicitly calls it a fork of ixmilia/dxf-go and enumerates changes. Exact source delta and test-provenance audit were not performed.
findings.dwgRoute: Documented DWG/xref conversion invokes LibreDWG dwg2dxf; it is not an independent DWG reader.
findings.acisRoute: No ACIS/AcDs parser or B-rep kernel route was documented in the reviewed package documentation.
findings.planUse: Only consider a narrowly scoped DXF structural/explicit-entity comparison if a concrete local gap remains. Pin source and artifact, inspect changed code/test provenance, and compare scratch-authored asymmetric controls to independent expectations. No CI dependency or per-slice invocation.

findings.evidence: The expanded search returned CADKernel, ft_model, Cadze, and other routes already covered by existing plan entries; their reviewed roles remain unsupported ACIS, 2D/projection, or LibreDWG-correlated consumer paths.
findings.planUse: No duplicate peer entry, execution, issue, or implementation task was added.

entryConditions: A specific unresolved local DXF structural or explicit-entity gap exists.
Exact tagged source/artifact is pinned and the fork delta from IxMilia is inspected.
The comparison lane is DXF-only, with input/version/mode and omitted records accounted for.
The expected values are independently authored; peer output is not its own oracle.
